ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: For each PMID: deepdive_manifest.py --pmid <PMID> --verify-artifacts --require-current-schema exits PASS with 0 gaps, run from the shared root checkout.
For each PMID: fulltext_receipts.py record --receipt <event.json> succeeded, and fulltext_receipts.py verify is OK afterwards.

For each PMID: a dossier in disease-models/wwox/research/fulltext_dossiers/PMID<PMID>.md that states what the reading found, what it does NOT support, and the transfer verdict toward the reference genotype.
Every evidentiary locator carries surface + fingerprinted artifact; abstract is never the evidentiary surface.
Figures inspected at native resolution wherever the images are lawfully retrievable; captions_only is declared as such and downgrades the receipt.
legend_lint.py . stays PASS after every commit.
A commit candidate exists for any reading that would change or qualify a registry record or a claim.
DEPENDENCIES: duplicate-work gate already run by the orchestrator over fulltext_read_receipts.jsonl on 2026-09-08
REVIEW_REQUIREMENT: Ladder floor R2. R4 / legend-locator-audit is REQUIRED before any reading is allowed to narrow, reverse, corroborate or remove a consolidated baseline claim, or to justify a MAJOR working-model bump.

15070730.finding: CLAIM 023 NARROW proposed. Its TITLE asserts phosphorylation-dependent subcellular rerouting; no experiment in the paper manipulates phosphorylation and measures localisation. 20 body sentences mention Src, ZERO also mention localisation, cytoplasm, nucleus, redistribution or sequestration. The claim's own SUMMARY is faithful — three separate facts; it is the title that welds two into an untested relation, and the title is what gets quoted. The binding leg is untouched and is the best-supported thing in the paper.
15070730.cost_of_paying_the_debt: The August receipt called Fig 5 the strongest form of the routing evidence. Opened, it is the weakest: no dose labels, no merge, no counts, no statistic, and its Wwox-positive area is not lower in the reduced-dose field. Paying the debt weakened the claim rather than strengthening it.
15070730.R4: SATISFIED — two independent blind auditors, 13 triples, 7 corrected. MY MOST ATTRACTIVE FINDING WAS WITHDRAWN IN FULL: the Fig 6 to Fig 5 cross-panel bridge fails on cell line (Fig 5 is NIH 3T3, Fig 6 the SAOS-2 series), verified against the body myself rather than on an auditor's word. Also withdrawn: 'on any measure' and its 99th-percentile pair, 'both panels contain both morphologies', 'straddling unity', 'lowest by a wide margin'. One correction ran in my favour: 8 Src sentences to 20. THE AUDITORS DISAGREED TWICE AND BOTH DISPUTES WERE ADJUDICATED FROM THE PIXELS: Fig 7 y-maxima are 60/60/120 (one auditor read 68/68/128 and was wrong, settled at 26x on glyph shape), and lane 10's window sensitivity is real while the auditor's proposed mechanism does not reproduce (centroid 155.75, inside the window).

24510053.finding: The re-audit rule paid. The review defines ubiquitination as labelling for degradation via the proteasomal system — a flat universal, no linkage determination, cited to a bone-formation review with no WWOX data. That is verbatim D-01 in DEFAULTS THAT BIT US, whose logged cost is discarding a testable ACK1/ITCH cascade for days. The same section names Ack1 and cites ref 31 = PMID 16288044, the primary source of the cascade ACTIVE REOPENED rejection DIS-001 turns on, whose own receipt status is an EMPTY LIST. So the review supplies DIS-001 its missing provenance while being itself an instance of the premise that closed it, and resolves nothing about linkage. DIS-001 proposed STRENGTHENED IN PROVENANCE, VERDICT UNCHANGED.
24510053.transfer_verdict: NEGATIVE AND MEASURED. Over the 38845-character body with the 103-item reference list separated off FIRST: zero occurrences of epilepsy, seizure, brain, CNS, WOREE, encephalopathy, ataxia, intellectual, recessive, syndrome, Q230, SCAR12. The only two 'neuro' hits in the file are journal names in the bibliography — back matter, the contamination class registered as open item 3 of the receipt contract, and separating body from refs before screening is what kept them out.
